purpose: Define the minimum deterministic traversal a generic machine reader uses to understand a Canonical Contract 1.4 tree without project-specific interpretation.

topics.name: Recursive Read Contract
topics.purpose: Define the minimum deterministic traversal a generic machine reader uses to understand a Canonical Contract 1.4 tree without project-specific interpretation.

semantics.topic_rule: Topic context is part of normal recursive reading.
semantics.dimension_rule: Containment, relation, ownership, authority and dependency are read separately.
semantics.prose_rule: Prose explains semantics but cannot be required to reconstruct missing machine-significant structure.
semantics.heuristic_rule: Filesystem naming and document ordering are not semantic fallback mechanisms.
semantics.termination_rule: Visited canonical identities are tracked to prevent accidental infinite traversal.

invariants.rule: A generic reader can resolve canonical identity, Topic context, references and semantic ownership without filesystem or prose heuristics.

hard_gates.condition: prose required to reconstruct missing machine semantics

prose.summary: Define the minimum deterministic traversal a generic machine reader uses to understand a Canonical Contract 1.4 tree without project-specific interpretation.
